page.content:
Storm and desert god who killed Osiris and contended with Horus.

How Set connects

  • Character: Osiris — Set murdered Osiris and seized the kingship.
  • Character: Horus — Horus contended with Set for Egypt's kingship.
  • Faction: Ennead — Set is one of the nine of Heliopolis.
  • Character: Apep — Set spears Apep in the night boat even while he wars with Horus.

What is Set?

Set is the necessary violent god: murderer of Osiris, usurper, and also the defender who spears the serpent Apep in Ra's night boat. Order needs him and must limit him.

Key threads lead to Osiris, Horus, Ennead and Apep.
